2607.14777.title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2607.14777.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly trained as interactive agents for long-horizon tasks involving multi-turn interaction, tool use, and environment feedback. Outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) provides a practical optimization paradigm, but its sparse trajectory-level rewards offer limited guidance on intermediate decisions, leaving a supervision gap between episode-level outcomes and token-level policy learning. We propose SEED (SElf-Evolving On-Policy Distillation), a self-evolving framework that converts completed on-policy trajectories into training-time hindsight skills and distills their behavioral effect back into the policy model. SEED first fine-tunes the policy to analyze completed trajectories and generate natural-language skills that capture reusable workflows, decisive observations, or failure-avoidance rules. During RL, the current policy both collects trajectories and serves as the analyzer that extracts hindsight skills from them. Policy updates therefore improve subsequent decision making and skill analysis together, allowing hindsight supervision to evolve with the policy. SEED then re-scores the sampled actions under ordinary and skill-augmented contexts, converting the skill-induced probability shift into a dense token-level on-policy distillation signal. This signal is jointly optimized with outcome-based RL, keeping the auxiliary supervision aligned with the current trajectory distribution. Extensive experiments on text-based and vision-based agentic tasks show that SEED consistently improves performance and sample efficiency, exhibiting robust generalization to unseen scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/jinyangwu/SEED.
2607.14777.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地被訓練為長期任務的互動代理，涉及多輪互動、工具使用和環境反饋。基於結果的強化學習（RL）提供了一種實用的優化範式，但其稀疏的軌跡級獎勵對中間決策的指導有限，留下了情節級結果和標記級策略學習之間的監督差距。我們提出了SEED（自我演變的在線蒸餾），這是一個自我演變的框架，將完成的在線軌跡轉換為訓練時的事後技能，並將其行為效果蒸餾回策略模型。SEED首先微調策略以分析已完成的軌跡，並生成捕捉可重用工作流程、關鍵觀察或避免失敗規則的自然語言技能。在強化學習過程中，當前策略同時收集軌跡並作為分析器從中提取事後技能。因此，策略更新同時改善後續決策和技能分析，使事後監督隨著策略的演變而演變。SEED然後在普通和技能增強的上下文中重新評分抽樣動作，將技能引起的概率變化轉換為密集的標記級在線蒸餾信號。這個信號與基於結果的強化學習共同優化，保持輔助監督與當前軌跡分佈的一致性。在基於文本和基於視覺的代理任務上的廣泛實驗顯示，SEED持續提高性能和樣本效率，對未見場景展現出強大的泛化能力。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/jinyangwu/SEED 獲得。
